subject: REPOSITORY paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1086/PB989/PB2103/PB4455: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.4 'the details are taken from the external repository for the program with the same name as the externalized name of the program prototype' -> OK 12.3.8.4 10) c)). NOTE 1: literal-3 is the externalized name. Verified, all three arms: RepositoryResolver.ResolveProgram is ONE search keyed by EXTERNALIZED name and run AS OF the referencing source element's position (BoundUnit.SourcePosition): a) over GroupRepositoryProvider, the first outermost program definition that starts BEFORE the element (its details; the repository's are ignored; kb/Work PB989), b) otherwise the group's first program prototype definition of that externalized name, c) otherwise MetadataRepositoryProvider.Program: the first entry of that kind and externalized name in the external repository (the --repository directories in the order given, default the output directory, then the --reference assemblies; DESIGN-external-repository 8.2, 8.6; docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 DOC-A.1-66), its signature decoded from the entry's host entry, and that program is the one called. A definition that FOLLOWS the REPOSITORY entry with no prototype ahead is neither a) nor b) and no entry answers it: REPO-1 (COBOL5962, SR14), never a silent run-time fallback with no details. Witnesses: a) negative pb989-call-previous-definition-argument-count; b) pb237_program_prototype, pb894_program_prototype_2002, pb2103_prototype_group_split_across_units (prototype and definition in two units, the group prototype's details used), RepositoryDetailsOrderTests; c) ExternalRepositoryResolutionTests.ACallerIsCheckedAgainstTheEntryInItsOutputDirectory (a CALL is refused COBOL1688 against the entry's formal, accepted for a conforming argument) and pb2103_program_of_85_through_prototype (the entry is a COBOL-85 program: details from the repository, that program called, EXIT PROGRAM returning); nothing answering is ASpecifierNoProviderAnswers_IsRepo1_NamingThePlacesSearched; the prototype itself is refused at 85 (pb2103_prototype_refused_at_85, COBOL0900). Re-probed 2026-11-03 on the PB1086 branch (kb/Work PB1086): the note's own sr10.cob (REPOSITORY. FUNCTION NOSUCHFN, FUNCTION ALIASFN AS "NOSUCH-EXT", PROGRAM NOSUCHPG, CLASS NOSUCHCL, INTERFACE NOSUCHIF, PROPERTY NOSUCHPR) is refused at --std 2023 with COBOL5962 at each of the six specifiers, naming the rule (SR10, SR14, SR6, SR9, SR16) and the places searched; sr6.cob (PROGRAM NOSUCHPG + CALL NOSUCHPG ON EXCEPTION) is refused COBOL5962 at the specifier instead of printing NOT-FOUND at run time.
